messages:
Erin Park: Heads-up: we9re activating a 72-hour reviewer surge to help clear backlog before calibration. Looking for volunteers for engineering, product, and ML reviews. Can take 1-4 each.

Devon Clarke: How will conflicts be handled if a volunteer is also a direct manager?

Erin Park: Don9t sign up for direct reports. We9ll validate via manager field on the form. Form: https://forms.redwood.com/review-surge-signup (quick fields: name, email, max extras, teams okay/not okay).

Rina Patel: Is there any compensation or time off allowance for heavy lifting weeks?

Erin Park: We9re offering a +2 workload buffer in next sprint allocation or 4 hours comp time per 3 extra reviews (choose one). Mention preference on the form.

People Ops Bot: reminder: Surge reviewers get auto-tag "surge" in dashboard and priority assignment 2 (after managers). SLA = 48h for surge reviewers. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/surge

Devon Clarke: Can I bulk add three folks from my pod? Any CSV template?

Erin Park: Yes, CSV template included on the form. Quick sample:```csv
email,max_extra,notes
devon.clarke@redwood.ai,2,backend only
alex.jones@redwood.ai,1,ok evenings
```

Rina Patel: Would be helpful to see an anonymized queue snapshot (high-effort counts) before committing.

People Ops Bot: update: Posting hourly anonymized counts in #people-ops during surge window. First post in 1h.

Erin Park: Thanks everyone. If you signed up, expect assignment emails within 4-12h. Ping me here for exceptions or if you need to opt into short forms only. :sparkles:
